title: Verter replacement-validation deviation ledger
description: The machine-readable source of truth for deviations found running real projects through Verter against reference tooling. Entries are HERMETIC: no project name, path, source byte, or verbatim diagnostic — only opaque ids, generic repro fixtures, and message shapes.

id.description: A stable ledger id (opaque; never a project name).

genericReproFixture.description: Path/identifier of the generic, vendored, hermetic repro fixture. REQUIRED before any landing.

reference.description: The reference tool + version the deviation was found against (e.g. 'vue-tsc 3.2.x').

ownerCrate.description: The lowest reusable owner crate a VERTER_BUG / HARNESS_OR_ORACLE_GAP fix lands in.

regressionTest.description: The discriminating regression/locking test that pins the intended behavior.

status.description: draft | final. A final/approved ruling has passed review.

independentRepro.description: An independent reproduction that does not rely on Verter's own projection as the oracle. REQUIRED for every non-VERTER_BUG affirmative ruling.

sourceOfTruth.description: A named specification, Vue runtime behavior, TypeScript behavior, or architecture ruling — never 'because Verter says so'. REQUIRED for non-VERTER_BUG.

reviewerApproval.description: Explicit reviewer approval. REQUIRED for non-VERTER_BUG.

lockingAssertion.description: A regression assertion that LOCKS the intended behavior so it cannot silently drift. REQUIRED for non-VERTER_BUG.

undecidedReason.description: Why the deviation is not yet ruled. REQUIRED when class == UNDECIDED.

nextAction.description: The concrete next step to resolve an UNDECIDED. REQUIRED when class == UNDECIDED.

allOf.$comment: Every affirmative non-VERTER_BUG ruling requires the four anti-misclassification fields.
UNDECIDED requires a reason + next action, and must NOT be final/approved.
